title: cfg_scale=7 optimal for dasiwa/LTX-2.3
detail: cfg_scale=7 is the confirmed best for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Composite 69.55 (run 20260620_161844) with cfg=7 vs 69.12 with cfg=5. Run 20260620_192226 reported cfg=7 as dead-end, but that run used a stale/mismatched baseline (stage1=16, cfg=5, frames=57 reused from .voice_runs.txt cache) — results from that run are invalid and should be ignored. On the correct best-config foundation (stage1=20, stage2=5, stg=1.5, modality=5, hq=true), cfg=7 is the winner.

title: audio_cfg_scale=3 is worst across all runs
detail: audio_cfg_scale=3.0 consistently worst across all runs — confirmed dead-end again in runs 20260620_202350, 20260624_060501, and 20260624_064108 (listed in deadEnds). Do not retry under any config.

title: LTX-2.3 dasiwa composite ceiling now 76.37 (audio_volume=15, seed=3053)
detail: LTX-2.3 dasiwa composite ceiling updated to 76.37 (run 20260624_193246) with config: stage1=20, stage2=5, cfg=7, stg_scale=1.5, modality_scale=5, hq=true, seed=3053, audio_cfg_scale=null, av_ca=1000, audio_volume=15. Prior ceiling was 71.94 at audio_volume=50 (runs through 20260624_081922). audio_volume sweep raised composite: 50→30 (74.36) → 30→15 (76.37, +4.43 over prior ceiling). av_ca sweep: av_ca=200 yielded 69.34; av_ca=500 yielded 68.51; av_ca=2000 yielded 69.33 — all below margin, rejected. quality.edge remains the weakest metric; voice.dynamic_range is the audio bottleneck. Run 20260624_193246: stage2_steps=3 and modality_scale=6 both failed to move the needle from 76.37.

title: stage1/stage2 step overrides partially superseded
detail: SUPERSEDED: stage1_steps=20 was ADOPTED in run 20260620_130253 (composite 69.12) and stage2_steps=5 also adopted. Original finding was context-specific (no modality_scale=5 foundation). With hq+modality_scale=5 as baseline, step overrides CAN help. Only stage1_steps=25 with low_ram+hq remains dangerous (FileNotFoundError crash).

title: LTX-2.3 dasiwa best config: composite=76.37 at audio_volume=15, seed=3053
detail: LTX-2.3 dasiwa TRUE BEST config (updated run 20260624_193246): cfg_scale=7, stg_scale=1.5, hq=true, stage1_steps=20, stage2_steps=5, modality_scale=5, seed=3053, audio_cfg_scale=null, av_ca=1000 (default), audio_volume=15, composite=76.37. Prior best was composite=71.94 at audio_volume=50 (runs through 20260624_081922). audio_volume=15 raised composite by 4.43 points. The optimal audio_volume path: 50→30 (composite 74.36 adopted) → 30→15 (composite 76.37 adopted). av_ca=200/500/2000, modality_scale=7/6/4/2, audio_stage1_only=true, audio_cfg_scale non-null all confirmed failed. stage2_steps=3 and modality_scale=6 failed in run 20260624_193246. This is the verified plateau config.

title: audio_stage1_only=true is a dead-end for dasiwa
detail: audio_stage1_only=true rejected on the correct best config in run 20260620_161844 (composite 69.27 vs 69.55 baseline, below 1.5 margin). Run 20260620_192226 appeared to adopt it at 59.6, but that run used an invalid stale baseline (wrong mp4) — that adoption is meaningless. Confirmed dead-end in runs 20260624_060501 and 20260624_064108 deadEnds list (tanks quality to 40.7 without other levers). Net: audio_stage1_only=true is NOT beneficial on the current best config. Do not retry.

title: --hq mode is the primary quality lever (+4.5 composite)
detail: --hq (TI2VidTwoStagesHQPipeline, res_2s second-order Runge-Kutta sampler) is the primary quality lever for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Raises composite 58.5->62.98 (+4.5) at cfg=5+stage1=15. Fixes quality.edge (was 17-31, now not weakest). New weakest: voice.snr=4.8 dB. --hq is now dasiwa CLI default. Not compatible with --distilled.

title: modality_scale=5 is the only beneficial value; adjacent values all regress
detail: modality_scale=5 adopted in run 20260620_120410: pushed composite to 63.93 on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 (hq=true, cfg=5, stage1=15, stage2=3, seed=42). Still active in 20260620_130253 as part of best config (composite 69.12). modality_scale=2 consistently regressed; modality_scale=7 confirmed regression in run 20260620_202350 (composite 58.21 vs ~59.6 at default 5). modality_scale=4 regressed to 71.66 in run 20260624_081922. modality_scale=6 regressed delta=-0.05 in run 20260624_193246 (composite 76.32 vs 76.37 baseline, condition: stage1=20/stage2=5/cfg=7/stg=1.5/hq=true/seed=3053/av_ca=1000/audio_volume=15). The failure of values 2, 4, 6, and 7 confirms a sharply-peaked resonance curve centered at 5 — the LTX-2.3 cross-modal diffusion was trained with a specific modality weighting calibration that lacks generalization away from value=5. Only value 5 is confirmed beneficial; do not retry any adjacent value.

title: modality_scale=2 regresses composite
detail: modality_scale=2 regresses composite vs modality_scale=5 for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Tried in run 20260620_120410 and confirmed dead-end again in 20260620_130253. Consistently yields ~59.96 vs 63.93+ at scale=5. Do not retry modality_scale=2.

title: stg_scale=1.5 outperforms default 1.0 on modality_scale=5 foundation
detail: stg_scale=1.5 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 2): pushed composite 63.93->66.61 on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 (hq=true, cfg=5, stage2=5, modality_scale=5, seed=42). Prior default stg_scale=1.0 confirmed optimal in A/B test, but 1.5 outperforms on the modality_scale=5+stage2=5 foundation. stg_scale=2 is a dead-end (crashes with FileNotFoundError).

title: stg_scale=2.0 crashes with FileNotFoundError
detail: stg_scale=2.0 causes generation_failed (FileNotFoundError: distilled LoRA path resolution fails) for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Confirmed in runs 20260620_130253, 20260620_141128, 20260620_161844, 20260620_202350, and 20260624_060501 (deadEnds). stg_scale=1.5 is the current sweet spot — going to 2 triggers a crash, not just regression.

title: stage2_steps=5 is the confirmed optimum; steps=3 and steps=7 yield no gain
detail: stage2_steps=5 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 1, composite 63.93 on that step). Part of the final best config achieving composite 69.12. stage2_steps=5 vs default 3 improves refinement quality for dasiwa/LTX-2.3 when hq=true and modality_scale=5. stage2_steps=7 tried in run 20260624_081922: no composite gain (71.94 vs 71.94, delta=0.00). stage2_steps=3 tried in run 20260624_193246: no composite gain (76.37 vs 76.37, delta=0.00, weakest: quality.edge, condition: cfg=7/stg=1.5/modality=5/hq=true/seed=3053/av_ca=1000/audio_volume=15). Both above and below 5 are exhausted — refinement depth cannot overcome the codec/quality ceiling. stage2_steps=5 is the confirmed optimum; do not retry any other value.

title: stage1_steps=20 optimal; stage1_steps=25 off-limits
detail: stage1_steps=20 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 4): pushed composite 66.61->69.12. stage1_steps=25 consistently fails (dead-end in runs 20260620_130253, 20260620_141128, 20260620_161844, 20260620_202350, 20260624_060501 — all rejected as incompatible with dasiwa low_ram, requires distilled LoRA safetensors not available). When building on hq+modality_scale=5 foundation, stage1_steps=20 is beneficial. stage1_steps=25 is definitively off-limits for dasiwa.

title: stage1_steps=25 and stg_scale>=2 crash with distilled LoRA
detail: stage1_steps=25 and stg_scale>=2.0 with --hq and distilled LoRA cause FileNotFoundError (distilled LoRA path resolution fails). Confirmed in runs 20260620_130253, 20260620_141128, 20260620_161844, 20260620_202350, 20260624_060501, and referenced in 20260624_064108 deadEnds ('low_ram+dasiwa incompatible with non-default LoRA strength — distilled LoRA missing errors'). Keep stage1_steps<=20 and stg_scale<=1.5 when using hq+distilled LoRA combination.

title: LTX-2.3 dasiwa composite plateau now at 76.37 after audio_volume=15 adoption
detail: LTX-2.3 dasiwa composite reached a new plateau at 76.37 (run 20260624_193246, audio_volume=15), up from prior plateau of 71.94 (audio_volume=50 default, run 20260624_081922). All knob families swept: audio (cfg_scale null-optimal, stage1_only harmful — all worse), structural (stg_scale, step counts, modality_scale — levers adopted), deep audio (av_ca: 200/500 rejected; av_ca=2000 rejected), and audio_volume (50→30→15 sweep: 15 is confirmed best). In run 20260624_193246: stage2_steps=3 (no gain, quality.edge weakest) and modality_scale=6 (delta=-0.05) both failed. Refinement depth (stage2_steps) exhausted — neither going above 5 nor below 5 helps. modality_scale resonance curve now has 4 data points (2/4/6/7 all regress); only 5 is optimal. The 76.37 ceiling is the current hard plateau without a new pipeline/model.

title: audio_cfg_scale non-null regresses vs null by 0.4-1.2 pts consistently
detail: Any explicit audio_cfg_scale value regresses vs null (default) on dasiwa/LTX-2.3. audio_cfg_scale=5 yielded 68.39 in run 20260620_161844 (vs 69.55 baseline) and 71.48 in run 20260624_064108 (vs 71.94 baseline, delta=-0.46, weakest: voice.dynamic_range). audio_cfg_scale=3 confirmed worst across all runs. Pattern: explicit non-null values regress composite by 0.4-1.2 points consistently, confirming null (default guidance) is optimal. audio_cfg_scale cannot overcome the voice.dynamic_range codec ceiling. Keep audio_cfg_scale=null. Sweeping audio_cfg_scale is no longer productive.

title: Stale .voice_runs.txt mp4 cache invalidates entire run
detail: Workflow baseline phase may reuse a STALE mp4 from output/.voice_runs.txt that was generated with a different config (e.g., stage1=16, cfg=5, frames=57). When this happens, the entire run's comparisons become invalid — downstream proposals compare against the wrong score, causing spurious adoptions and dead-end misclassifications. Run 20260620_192226 was fully invalidated by this bug. Stale mp4 cache also confirmed as dead-end source in run 20260624_060501 ('Stale mp4 cache invalidates entire run'). Fix: baseline agent must verify all key config fields match before reusing. Always check stage1, stage2, cfg, stg, modality, hq, avCa, frames in the cached entry.

title: modality_scale=7 significantly regresses composite
detail: modality_scale=7 regresses composite significantly vs modality_scale=5 for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Confirmed dead-end in run 20260620_202350 (composite ~58.21 vs ~59.6 with default 5 — a regression of >1 point). Earlier test in run 20260620_192226 was from invalid stale baseline, but run 20260620_202350 confirms the regression from a valid baseline. modality_scale=5 remains the only beneficial value. Do not retry modality_scale=7.

title: av_ca non-default values all fail; default 1000 is optimal
detail: av_ca_timestep_scale_multiplier sweep confirms default (1000.0) is optimal for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Full range tested: av_ca=200 yielded composite 69.34 (below 1.5 margin, run 20260620_202350, rejected); av_ca=500 yielded composite 68.51 (regression, run 20260620_202350, rejected); av_ca=2000 yielded composite 69.33 in both iterations of run 20260624_060501 (below margin, rejected); av_ca=1000 confirmed again as default in run 20260624_064108 best config. Both below-default and above-default values fail. Do not retry any av_ca value other than the default 1000.0.

title: seed=3053 raises dasiwa composite from 69.55 to 71.94
detail: seed=3053 adopted in run 20260624_064108 (iteration 1): composite raised from 69.55 (seed=42 baseline) to 71.94 (+2.39 points) on the best config (stage1=20, stage2=5, cfg=7, stg_scale=1.5, modality_scale=5, hq=true, av_ca=1000). Confirmed active in run 20260624_193246 as part of the best config enabling composite=76.37 (combined with audio_volume=15). seed=42 was the prior best across 8+ runs. Seed acts as a stochastic lever over the audio diffusion path, capable of meaningful composite improvement without any structural change.

title: Seed swaps trade voice naturalness vs quality.edge — not universal improvement
detail: Seed 7291 yielded composite 73.42 (audio score 88.5, best observed) but was REJECTED in run 20260624_064108 because quality.edge (weakest dimension) regressed below the 1.5-point adoption margin. Seed acts as a stochastic lever that decouples voice clarity from visual edge fidelity: higher voice naturalness can co-vary with spatial coherence loss (edge_density = Sobel gradient magnitude, proxy for geometric frame sharpness). When evaluating new seeds, check BOTH voice metrics AND quality.edge — a high audio score alone is insufficient for adoption. Seed adoption requires all weakest-dimension scores to stay above baseline-minus-margin.

title: stage2_steps=7 yields no composite gain on current best config
detail: stage2_steps=7 tried in run 20260624_081922 (iteration 1): composite 71.94 vs baseline 71.94 (delta=0.00). Weakest dimension: voice.dynamic_range. Increasing refinement depth from 5 to 7 cannot overcome the voice.dynamic_range codec bottleneck — the plateau is an audio encoding ceiling, not a denoising ceiling. Additional denoising passes cannot improve a dimension that is codec-bound. Do not retry stage2_steps>5 under this config.

title: modality_scale=4 regresses composite on current best config
detail: modality_scale=4 tried in run 20260624_081922 (iteration 2): composite 71.66 vs baseline 71.94 (delta=-0.28). Weakest dimension: voice.dynamic_range. modality_scale=4 regresses composite, reinforcing the sharply-peaked resonance curve centered at value=5. The LTX-2.3 cross-modal diffusion was trained with a specific modality weighting calibration that lacks generalization in the latent space — values adjacent to 5 (tested: 2, 4, 7) all regress meaningfully. Do not retry modality_scale=4.

title: modality_scale has sharply-peaked resonance at 5; values 2/4/6/7 all regress
detail: modality_scale exhibits a sharply-peaked resonance curve centered at value=5 for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Tested values and outcomes: modality_scale=2 regressed (runs 20260620_120410, 20260620_130253); modality_scale=4 regressed delta=-0.28 (run 20260624_081922); modality_scale=5 optimal at composite 76.37 (best config, run 20260624_193246); modality_scale=6 regressed delta=-0.05 (run 20260624_193246, composite 76.32 vs 76.37 baseline, condition: stage1=20/stage2=5/cfg=7/stg=1.5/hq=true/seed=3053/av_ca=1000/audio_volume=15); modality_scale=7 regressed composite ~58.21 (run 20260620_202350). The LTX-2.3 cross-modal diffusion appears trained with a specific modality weighting calibration that lacks generalization away from value=5 in the latent space. Four data points now confirm the resonance curve — any modality_scale sweep away from 5 is not worth attempting.

title: audio_volume=15 raises dasiwa composite from 71.94 to 76.37 (+4.43 pts)
detail: audio_volume sweep adopted in run 20260624_193246: audio_volume 50→30 (composite 74.36, adopted, iter 1) then 30→15 (composite 76.37, adopted, iter 2). Net gain: +4.43 composite points over the prior ceiling. audio_volume=15 is confirmed best for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. The knob controls output audio amplitude; lower volume apparently reduces clipping/saturation artifacts that were suppressing voice quality metrics. Condition: stage1=20, stage2=5, cfg=7, stg=1.5, modality=5, hq=true, seed=3053, av_ca=1000, audio_cfg_scale=null. audio_volume=15 is now part of the canonical best config.

title: stage2_steps=3 yields no composite gain; quality.edge is weakest
detail: stage2_steps=3 tried in run 20260624_193246 (iteration 3): composite 76.37 vs baseline 76.37 (delta=0.00, weakest: quality.edge). Reducing refinement from 5 to 3 yields no composite improvement — stage2 provides no granular quality returns below the 5-step optimum. Reducing iterations does not crash output but yields no gains; edge-quality degradation is the structural casualty. stage2 is already minimally parameterized for the current modality at value=5. Do not retry stage2_steps<5.

title: modality_scale=6 regresses composite delta=-0.05 on current best config
detail: modality_scale=6 tried in run 20260624_193246 (iteration 4): composite 76.32 vs baseline 76.37 (delta=-0.05, weakest: quality.edge). Confirms the sharply-peaked resonance at value=5 — value=6 (immediately adjacent above) regresses minimally but consistently, while value=7 regresses massively (-13+ pts). The gradient from 5→6 is small but negative; from 5→7 is catastrophic. modality_scale sweep in either direction from 5 is exhausted: 4 fails, 6 fails, 2 fails, 7 crashes performance. Do not retry modality_scale=6.
